title: 第9章 练气一层
content_zh:
“总算是出来种田了，要不然，就该按照规矩惩罚你们了！”

    下午时候，王管事背着手腆着肚子冷笑着走过两人灵田前面，说了这么一句话。

    韩榆与李老道一开始不解其意，问了一下张山才知道，拿到灵米种子三日内不开始种地，是要受罚的。

    只是一般来说，管事只是提醒督促；王管事这样的横行霸道的，是真有可能对他们这些杂役弟子进行严惩。

    李老道听后，免不了又低声咒骂两句。

    当天晚上，韩榆喂过了大乌鸦，又复制灵米，盘膝凝聚气流。

    第二日，将剩余的灵田种植完毕。

    第三日，开始以水桶提着山泉水灌溉灵田，路程不短，每日勉强只能灌溉一亩……

    如此七八日后，韩榆终于将种植青禾灵米的播种、浇水等工作做完，按照孙康、张山、刘兰他们的说法，接下来的时间除了盯着灵田内有无虫害，每月浇水两次，大部分时间可以进行修炼了。

    每日一个灵米饭团的供养之下，韩榆的体内气流增长很快，已经大约到了一个周天的五分之一。

    估计再这么修行一多个月后，应该就能运行第一次周天，达到练气一层。

    对比杂役弟子的前辈们，这样已经是非常快了——五灵根的张山，当初练气一层用了一年多；四灵根的孙康，练气一层也用了六七个月。

    有充足的灵米作为食物，显然能够极大的促进一开始修炼的进展。

    这一段时间，李老道也是白天干活，夜里修行，本来放下的炼血诀也又靠着骏马精血继续练起来。

    这一日，李老道兴冲冲地跑到韩榆屋里，脸色通红：“我感应到气感了！”

    “小娃儿，你感应到没有？道爷我给你讲讲感受！”

    韩榆有些愕然：“气感？”

    那不是他开始吃灵米饭团就开始有的吗？

    这时候，韩榆才知道方执事为什么当初对自己多看一眼，对李老道懒得置评。原来李老道这样的年龄、又是五灵根，修行真正是千难万难，几乎没有希望。

    李老道兴致勃勃拉着韩榆讲了半天“气感”的感受，又激动地连声说自己修仙正途果然是有希望的！

    韩榆见他这样，倒是也不好说什么，只是默不作声听着。

    最后李老道才心满意足地走了。
content_en:
"Finally come out to farm, otherwise, you should be punished according to the rules!"

In the afternoon, Manager Wang walked past the two people's cemetery with his hands behind his back and a sneer, saying this.

Han Yu and Li Laodao were puzzled at first, but after asking Zhang Shan they found out that they would be punished if they did not start farming within three days after receiving the spiritual rice seeds.

But generally speaking, stewards only remind and urge; a domineering and domineering steward like them is really likely to severely punish the handyman disciples like them.

After hearing this, Li Laodao couldn't help but curse in a low voice.

That night, Han Yu fed the crow, copied the spiritual rice, and crossed his legs to condense the airflow.

On the second day, the remaining spiritual fields were planted.

On the third day, I began to carry mountain spring water in buckets to irrigate the spiritual field. The journey was not short, and I could barely irrigate one acre per day...

After seven or eight days of this, Han Yu finally completed the sowing and watering of the green rice. According to Sun Kang, Zhang Shan, and Liu Lan, in the following time, in addition to keeping an eye on the spiritual field for pests and watering it twice a month, most of the time can be spent practicing.

With the support of a spiritual rice ball every day, Han Yu's body's air flow increased rapidly, reaching about one-fifth of a week.

It is estimated that after practicing like this for more than a month, I should be able to run the first Zhoutian and reach the first level of Qi training.

Compared with the predecessors of the handyman disciples, this is already very fast - Zhang Shan, who has five spiritual roots, spent more than a year practicing the first level of Qi; Sun Kang, who has four spiritual roots, also spent six or seven months practicing the first level of Qi.

Having enough spiritual rice as food can obviously greatly promote the progress of cultivation at the beginning.

During this period of time, Li Laodao also worked during the day and practiced at night. He continued to practice the blood refining technique that he had put aside, relying on the blood of the horse.

On this day, Li Laodao ran to Han Yu's house excitedly, his face flushed: "I feel the energy!"

"Little baby, do you feel it? Master Dao, let me tell you how you feel!"

Han Yu was a little stunned: "Sense of Qi?"

Didn't that happen when he started eating spiritual rice balls?

At this time, Han Yu realized why Deacon Fang took a second look at him and didn't bother to comment on Old Dao Li.It turns out that at Li Laodao's age and with five spiritual roots, cultivation is really difficult and almost hopeless.

Li Laodao excitedly talked to Han Yu about the feeling of "Qi" for a long time, and said excitedly that there was indeed hope for him to cultivate immortality on the right path!

Seeing him like this, Han Yu didn't know what to say, so he just listened silently.

Finally, Li Laodao left with satisfaction.
